Task #1151: Require memory header, list bad ones

## Goal

Make wrap-up write the memory-file header Claude Code reads (`name`, `description`, `metadata.type`), and make `list-drift.py` list a file whose header is missing or wrong, so no memory file lands headerless again. Owner approved the finding (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1148). Prior work: #433 and #446 (wrap-up merge) and #1094 (memory home); none set a header.

- Cause: `homework/skills/wrap-up/SKILL.md` Domain **Memory file** defines the body lines only, and `references/retro.md` step 5 **Add** names only `confirmed` and `last-confirmed`.
- A bad header is: no frontmatter; a `name` that differs from the file name without `.md`; no `description`; a `metadata.type` that is not `user`, `feedback`, `project` or `reference`.
- Scope: the SKILL.md line, the retro.md **Add** line, `scripts/list-drift.py` with a reader in `homework/lib/memory.py`, and a fixture pool in `homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/`. `MEMORY.md` is not a memory file and stays unchecked.
- Order: #1149 waits on this task.

## Definition of done

1. [check] **Skill names the header**: `grep -c 'metadata.type' homework/skills/wrap-up/SKILL.md` prints `1`; on base `0`.
2. [check] **Add step names the header**: `grep -c 'metadata.type' homework/skills/wrap-up/references/retro.md` prints `1`; on base `0`.
3. [check] **Headerless file listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header: .*headerless.md'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
4. [check] **Wrong name listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header: .*wrong-name.md.*name'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
5. [check] **Missing description listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header: .*no-description.md.*description'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
6. [check] **Bad type listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header: .*bad-type.md.*metadata.type'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
7. [check] **Only the bad files listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header'` prints `5`; on base `0`.
8. [check] **Pool holds the files that must pass**: `ls homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/good.md homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/blank-line.md homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l` prints `3`; on base `0`.

9. [check] **Index stays headerless**: `test -f homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/MEMORY.md && grep -c "^---" homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/MEMORY.md` prints `0`; on base nothing.

10. [check] **Retro runs the check**: `grep -c 'bad header' homework/skills/wrap-up/references/retro.md` prints `1`; on base `0`.
11. [check] **Real memory raises no alarm**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py ~/.claude ~/.claude/memory ~/.claude/memory/*/ homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header'` prints `5`; on base `0`.
12. [check] **Type under another key listed**: `python3 homework/skills/wrap-up/scripts/list-drift.py /nonexistent homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool 2>&1 | grep -c 'bad header: .*outside-metadata.md.*metadata.type'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
